text: Errors raised before streaming begins return an HTTP status (400 bad request/invalid JSON, 404 model not found, 429 rate limit, 500 internal, 502 bad gateway when a cloud model is unreachable) with a JSON body {"error": "<message>"}. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-14)
keywords: Ollama REST API: generate and chat with streaming NDJSON and errors and usage

text: If an error occurs after streaming has started, the server emits a line with an `error` property in the NDJSON stream and the HTTP status stays 200. Docs example: {"error":"an error was encountered while running the model"}. (medium confidence)
keywords: Ollama REST API: generate and chat with streaming NDJSON and errors and usage

text: Robust client rule: parse each line separately, check for an `error` key before reading content, and treat a stream that ends without done:true as incomplete. A reader that only joins `response` fields can return partial text and silently drop the error line. (low confidence)
keywords: Ollama REST API: generate and chat with streaming NDJSON and errors and usage

text: Per the api.md reference, done_reason "load" is returned for a chat call with empty messages (loads the model) and "unload" for an empty prompt/messages with keep_alive:0. keep_alive defaults to 5m. Raw mode (raw:true) skips templating and returns no `context`; `context` is deprecated. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-14)
keywords: Ollama REST API: generate and chat with streaming NDJSON and errors and usage

text: Clients that expect a single JSON object from a streaming-default endpoint fail with parse errors (e.g. 'JSON Parse error: Unexpected EOF'); the workaround is stream:false. (low confidence)
keywords: Ollama REST API: generate and chat with streaming NDJSON and errors and usage

text: /api/generate and /api/chat stream by default; the stream is NDJSON served as application/x-ndjson, one JSON object per line. Setting "stream": false returns a single application/json object with the full text and done:true. (high confidence)
keywords: Ollama REST API: generate and chat with streaming NDJSON and errors and usage

text: Generate chunks put text in the `response` field; chat chunks put it in `message.content`. The last chunk sets done:true and carries done_reason (e.g. "stop"). (high confidence)
keywords: Ollama REST API: generate and chat with streaming NDJSON and errors and usage

text: Final-chunk usage fields: total_duration, load_duration, prompt_eval_count, prompt_eval_cached_count, prompt_eval_duration, eval_count, eval_duration. All durations are nanoseconds; counts are tokens. Usage appears only in the done:true chunk. (medium confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-14)
keywords: Ollama REST API: generate and chat with streaming NDJSON and errors and usage

text: Output tokens per second = eval_count / eval_duration * 10^9 (eval_duration is nanoseconds). The docs example 18 tokens in 52,479,709 ns is about 343 tokens/s. (medium confidence)
keywords: Ollama REST API: generate and chat with streaming NDJSON and errors and usage
